baseline_construction_method.value: Ordinary least squares regression of the natural log of total source energy on the natural logs of clinker capacity and labor plus operating ratios (wet kiln ratio, clinker-to-cement and clinker-to-capacity ratios, squared clinker-to-capacity, and average-capacity x kiln-count interactions), estimated on 862 plant-year observations for ~96 US cement plants (2000-2008); the regression error term (assumed log-normal, with heteroscedastic variance modelled as a function of average kiln capacity) is used as the measure of plant-level energy-efficiency dispersion.
baseline_construction_method.evidence_quote: The EPI uses a statistical model to control for aspects of production that systematically influence the energy use. The regression error term is treated as a measure of plant-specific efficiency

scope_description.value: Whole-plant (facility-level) energy-efficiency benchmarking of US cement manufacturing plants: total source energy of the entire plant across the industry (~96 plants, 2000-2008).
